transcript.text: Good morning. I'd like to get our weekly logistics review started so we can finalize the temperature-controlled bay schedule for this week. We have two windows available — Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800, and Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800 — and both medical supplies and avionics batteries need the bay. Before we settle on assignments, I need to understand the requirements and timing from both of you. Let's start with the medical logistics officer: what's the expected receipt window for the medical supplies, and are there any handling constraints we need to document? And signal logistics, same questions for the avionics batteries.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I confirmed with the clinic warehouse this morning that the medical shipment arrives Tuesday at 0600 and must remain in temperature-controlled storage through Wednesday at 1800. The receiving manifest has not yet been added to the battalion storage schedule. The clinic also requires a temperature log every 4 hours during that window.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with the battery technician that the avionics battery shipment is scheduled for the Thursday window — Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800 — and requires a charge-status verification at Thursday 1200 before storage. The technician's note is still being filed with the signal section rather than the battalion schedule.
transcript.speaker: A3
